learning_outcomes.text: Use fundamental concepts of computer science and information technology
Explanation and interpretation of software packages for design and optimization of representative electrical systems
Computer aided design of basic electrical engineering subjects
Interpretation of results obtained with CAD software packages

syllabus_topics: Basics of Matlab. Applications – Point by point method. Solving differential equation in Matlab.
Computer aided design examples: Circuits in transient regime.
Application – Defining the melting time of a fuse – Method of finite differences.
GUI - Graphical User Interfaces
Equations, differential equations of electromagnetic and thermal field. Electrostatic field model.
Steady-state electrical field model. Magnetostatic field model. Magnetodynamic field model. Differential model of thermal conduction.
Finite element method. Variational formulation. Finite element numerical solution. 1D problem.
FEM in thermal field analysis. Example: Heating evaluation of a linear conductor in electrokinetic regime. 2D numerical model in finite element for evaluation of AC resistance of a solid conductor.
Partial differential equation toolbox. Electrostatic field model. Modeling of an electromagnet
Applications in PDE toolbox: Numerical model of a capacitive transducer. Numerical model of an inductive proximity transducer.
Software package FLUX. Computer aided design of a DC electromagnet.
Coupling the electromagnetic field regime with transient thermal. Application in FLUX.
Optimization problems solved in Optimization Matlab Toolbox. Examples.
Optimization problems in electrical engineering. Inverse problems. Applications: coil optimization, transversal flux inductor
Matlab functions assisting the students in solving applications on computer
Solving the differential equations assisting the students in solving applications on computer
Solving the transient regime at a DC motor startup assisting the students in solving applications on computer
Creating graphical user interfaces assisting the students in solving applications on computer
Applications in PDE Toolbox assisting the students in solving applications on computer
Applications in Flux2D assisting the students in solving applications on computer
Application in Optimization Toolbox assisting the students in solving applications on computer
teaching_methods: Course lectures with notes on blackboard and Power Point presentation
assessment_rules: To pass the subject, a grade of 5 or higher is required. The final mark is determined by 80% from the course evaluation and 20% from laboratory activities.
